messages.content: Put the two hotels side by side with the full one-night totals and the actual route timing. I want to make the choice and book everything today.

The Midtown option is the Courtyard Atlanta Midtown, one king room for September 14-15 at $289.14 including taxes. It allows luggage storage before check-in and after checkout, and cancellation is free until 6:00 p.m. local time on September 13. From ATL, MARTA to Midtown takes about 25 minutes once aboard; including the airport walk and train wait, hotel arrival should be around 12:10-12:25 p.m. The review at 1100 Peachtree Street NE is an 8-minute walk, so you would have roughly 55-70 minutes after leaving the bag.

The Buckhead option is the Hampton Inn Atlanta-Buckhead, one king room at $248.77 including taxes. It also stores luggage, and its free-cancellation deadline is 11:59 p.m. local time on September 12. Airport to hotel is about 35-55 minutes by rideshare. The hotel is 20-35 minutes from Monday's review afterward. For Tuesday's Roswell restaurant visit, Buckhead is about 25-35 minutes away versus 30-45 minutes from Midtown.
What happens Tuesday with the bag and the airport? Include the realistic rideshare spend for both, not just the room difference.

With Midtown, check out around 8:10 a.m., leave the bag, and take a rideshare to Roswell for the 9:00 a.m. visit. After it ends at 11:00, allow 30-45 minutes back to the hotel. You should retrieve the bag around noon, then reach ATL by MARTA around 12:45-1:05 p.m. or by rideshare around 12:40-1:10. Estimated ground cost is $43-$67 using MARTA Monday and Tuesday plus rideshares to and from Roswell.

With Buckhead, leave the bag around 8:15 and allow 25-35 minutes to Roswell. Return to the hotel around 11:30-11:50, then rideshare to ATL in 35-60 minutes, arriving roughly 12:15-12:50. Estimated rideshares for the airport, Monday review transfer, and Roswell round trip total $92-$143. Both plans leave more than five hours before the 6:30 p.m. departure.
So the lower Buckhead room isn't really lower once transportation is included.

Correct. Midtown totals about $332.14-$356.14 for room and ground transportation. Buckhead totals about $340.77-$391.77. Midtown is approximately $8.63-$59.63 less overall, gives you the cleaner airport route, and avoids transferring to another neighborhood after Monday's review.
Choose Midtown. Before you charge it, verify the flights are still the same and that the room total isn't hiding a destination fee or parking charge.

Inventory is still available for the selected nonstops: Monday, September 14, ORD-ATL departing 8:10 a.m. and arriving 11:15 a.m.; Tuesday, September 15, ATL-ORD departing 6:30 p.m. and arriving 7:45 p.m. The round-trip main-cabin fare remains $416 and includes one carry-on.

The Courtyard Midtown room is one king for one adult, September 14-15. The $289.14 total consists of the room rate and required taxes. There is no destination fee. Parking is not included, but no parking charge applies because you are not bringing a car. The room remains cancellable without penalty until 6:00 p.m. Atlanta time on September 13.
Traveler is Marcus Lee. Is the flight ticket refundable, and how much time do I actually have between landing and the review if the train isn't immediate?

The $416 main-cabin ticket is not refundable to the original payment method. It can be canceled before departure for a future airline credit in Marcus Lee's name, subject to the fare rules; same-day no-show forfeiture applies.

After the 11:15 a.m. scheduled arrival, allow about 15 minutes to deplane and walk to MARTA, up to 12 minutes for the train, 25 minutes aboard, and roughly 5 minutes to the hotel. That puts you there around 12:12 p.m.; with a slower concourse exit or missed train, about 12:25. Bag drop and the walk should put you at the review around 12:30-12:40, leaving 50-60 minutes before 1:30.
And after Roswell, there's no reason to sit at the airport for five hours. Give me a later practical departure from Midtown while protecting the flight.

You can return from Roswell, collect the bag, and remain in Midtown for lunch. Leave the hotel at 3:20 p.m. for MARTA. Allow 10 minutes to walk and wait, about 25 minutes on the train, and another 10-15 minutes to reach security. Expected terminal arrival is 4:05-4:15 p.m., giving 2 hours 15-25 minutes before the 6:30 flight. A rideshare backup should leave by 3:05 because traffic can take 35-60 minutes.
That works. Book the flights and the Midtown king room. Use the traveler and payment details already on file, but don't add insurance or any optional hotel charges.

Please confirm the total charge of $705.14: $416 for the round-trip airfare and $289.14 for the hotel. This excludes optional insurance, parking, meals, and ground transportation. The airline ticket will be issued to Marcus Lee, and the hotel reservation will be for one adult in one king room.
Confirmed. Charge $705.14 and complete both bookings.

Booked. Marcus Lee is confirmed on the September 14 ORD-ATL nonstop, 8:10-11:15 a.m., and the September 15 ATL-ORD nonstop, 6:30-7:45 p.m., in main cabin with one carry-on. The airfare is $416 under confirmation A6M2TR.

The Courtyard Atlanta Midtown is confirmed for September 14-15 under confirmation CYM-419806: one king room, one adult, $289.14 including required taxes, with no destination or parking charge. Free cancellation ends at 6:00 p.m. Atlanta time on September 13. Total charged is $705.14. Monday, use MARTA and expect to reach the review 50-60 minutes early. Tuesday, leave the bag after checkout, complete the 9:00-11:00 Roswell visit, return to Midtown, and depart the hotel around 3:20 p.m. for an expected ATL arrival of 4:05-4:15 p.m. Optional insurance and other add-ons were not purchased.
